author: Hailer Oy
description: Customer dashboard — assets, support tickets, contacts, opportunities, ManikinPC, rentals, online orders, and trips/IHS visits, all in one place for any client.
versionDescription: Fixed wrong statuses showing on Trips (and every other tab) — activity.currentPhase coming back from the list API is unreliable, so every card was showing whatever phase happened to come back instead of the phase it was actually fetched under. Now stamped with the known-correct phase at fetch time, fixing all 8 tabs at once. Also added a collapsed 'Closed' section at the bottom of the Trips tab so finished visits don't clutter the active list.
